capabilities: Browse files and folders on WebDAV servers
Drag and drop remote files into notes to generate markdown links
Preview videos and images inside Obsidian
Upload, download, and rename remote files and folders
Handle duplicate files on upload with overwrite, rename, or cancel options
disambiguation: Not a vault file browser; it browses and manages files on remote WebDAV servers, not local vault files.
extras: The README recommends configuring CORS headers on the WebDAV server for real-time previews; without CORS the plugin falls back to an authorization plus blob mode. The usage demo is only shown as a removed media/code block, so no working examples are visible.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to browse, preview, upload, or download files stored on a remote WebDAV server.

relations.evidence: Preview videos and images directly within Obsidian (Videos require Media Extended plugin)

summary: WebDAV client that browses remote servers, previews and transfers files, and generates markdown links via drag-and-drop.
